## Change
Describe the user-visible result in English.

## Verification
List only checks actually performed. Automated tests run during PR validation and the manual release workflow.

## Merge requirements
- Keep the PR focused on one coherent feature, fix, or maintenance task.
- Write the title and description in English.
- Use a Conventional Commit title, for example: feat(player): add double jump.
- The title becomes the squash commit and the release-note entry; make it understandable to players.
